raw.sql: SELECT SUM(fcb.interest_amount) AS net_interest_income, d.region FROM fct_monthly_balances fcb JOIN dim_branches d ON fcb.branch_id = d.branch_id WHERE fcb.balance_date >= '2026-07-01' AND fcb.balance_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY d.region ORDER BY net_interest_income DESC

raw+.sql: SELECT d.region, SUM(f.interest_amount) AS net_interest_income FROM fct_monthly_balances f JOIN dim_branches d ON f.branch_id = d.branch_id WHERE f.balance_date >= '2026-07-01' AND f.balance_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY d.region ORDER BY net_interest_income DESC

wren.sql:
SELECT region, SUM(net_interest_income) AS net_interest_income
FROM monthly_balances
WHERE balance_date <= '2026-09-30' AND balance_date >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY net_interest_income DESC

raw.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_deposits 
FROM fct_transactions t
JOIN fct_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN dim_products p ON a.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE t.transaction_date >= '2026-07-01' AND t.transaction_date < '2026-10-01' 
  AND t.channel = 'deposit'
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY total_deposits DESC;

raw.sql:
SELECT 
    b.region,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.days_past_due > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delinquent_accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.days_past_due > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS delinquency_rate
FROM fct_monthly_balances f
JOIN dim_branches b ON f.branch_id = b.branch_id
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY delinquency_rate DESC

raw+.sql:
SELECT 
  b.region,
  COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.days_past_due > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delinquent_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.days_past_due > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS delinquency_rate
FROM fct_monthly_balances m
JOIN dim_branches b ON m.branch_id = b.branch_id
WHERE m.days_past_due > 0
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY delinquency_rate DESC
